name: Dog
intro: A dog is a furry animal that lives with people. Dogs are pets and helpers.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: Dogs have four legs and a coat of fur.
Some dogs are tiny, and some are very big.
There are more than 400 kinds of dogs.
A dog wags its tail to show how it feels.
A grown dog has about 42 teeth.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Dogs live all over the world.
Many dogs live in homes with families.
Some dogs live and work on farms.
Dogs need a clean, cozy place to sleep.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Dogs eat meat and vegetables.
Dog food mixes these foods together.
Their sharp teeth are good for eating meat.
Dogs need healthy food to stay strong.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby dog is called a puppy.
A mother dog has about 6 puppies at a time.
Puppies drink milk from their mom.
All puppies are born deaf.
A dog is a puppy until about 1 year old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Every dog has its own nose print.
A dog's nose smells much better than ours.
Guide dogs help people who cannot see.
Dogs sweat through their paws.
Dogs were the first animals to live with people.

vocab.meaning: An animal with fur that feeds its babies milk.
One kind of dog, like a beagle or a poodle.
A group of babies born at the same time.
A dog that helps a person who cannot see.
